App link:- https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.herma.apps.textbooks

・Execution plan from our last meetups is here
・Photos from the meetups. Click here
・Pre-Project surveys were conducted before the first meetup to gauge participants' initial understanding of blockchain and Cardano technology. The form and user responses were attached in the PoA of the previous milestone (Pre-project meetup survey form is here and users' response is here).
・Post-Project survey conducted on final milestone after the project final meetup concluded to measure the increase in blockchain & cardano technology knowledge among students. We used the same form to collect users' responses after the final in-person meetup. (We removed some columns to avoid data privacy issues based of Roberta’s feedback on previous milestone)
・Gathered numerous positive feedbacks in Amharic language from students. Participants expressed appreciation for the comprehensive educational resources and interactive meetups. In addition to that, participants requests new features on the app such as quiz on each blockchain related modules
・Many meetup participants joined the cardano and catalyst ecosystem by participating on fund12. Highlighting their engagement on Catalyst fund12(including by proposing many ideas and participating on community review stage) and learning experience which demonstrated a clear increase in blockchain knowledge and active involvement.
・A detailed report analyzing the impact of the project on student awareness, summarizing the entire project, including the meetups and participation in the Cardano ecosystem was prepared and added on the closeout report document. Click here
・A Youtube video shared publicly showcases how users can search for the app on Google Play, download it, open it, and navigate through the features. The video demonstrates how to read blockchain courses and normal curriculum books with different options such as zooming in, adding/removing a course to favorites
